prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: a single transparent PNG car illustration for a children's English word card, displayed at approximately 140 by 110 CSS pixels.

Input images:
- Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a muted terracotta-coral-red compact three-box sedan. Preserve its distinctive terracotta-coral body color and compact sedan identity, including its short separate rear trunk, raised passenger cabin and front hood, while upgrading the primitive icon into a detailed children's picture-book illustration. Remove the existing word "Toyota".
- Image 2 is the PRIMARY STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its warm children's storybook illustration style, with clear warm dark-brown hand-drawn outlines, soft paper-like textured color fills, restrained volume, subtle highlights and warm gentle light. Do not copy its people, classroom, background or white border.
- Image 3 is the APPROVED SIBLING CAR ILLUSTRATION: match its level of detail, warm brown outlines, textured hand-painted color, friendly car proportions, window treatment, gentle shading and small soft contact shadow. Preserve the Toyota sedan silhouette and terracotta-coral color from image 1; do not turn it into the sibling yellow round hatchback.

Primary request: draw one complete small terracotta-coral-red three-box sedan facing RIGHT, in a very slight front-side three-quarter view, predominantly a side view. Both near-side wheels must be complete and grounded; a small naturally occluded far-side tire may be visible if perspective requires it, with no duplicated, floating or misplaced wheels. Include the whole car, mirrors, wheels and bumpers. Make the silhouette friendly and clean, with a short distinct trunk at the left rear, a softly rounded but recognizable sedan cabin, and a hood extending toward the right. Windows are softly pale blue-grey. Apply subtle volumetric shading, paper-like texture, a few restrained highlights and a small soft translucent contact shadow immediately beneath the wheels.
Composition: landscape transparent canvas with approximately a 14:11 aspect ratio, car centered, visible subject about 84% of the canvas width, and at least 8% comfortable transparent safety margin on every side. Remain readable and polished when reduced to 140 by 110 CSS pixels.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha everywhere outside the car and its small soft grounding shadow. No white or colored background, no scenery, no checkerboard baked into the image.
Constraints: one car only; no text, letters, numbers, emblems, brand logos, watermark, people, border, sticker outline or white halo. Keep the terracotta-coral-red color and compact three-box sedan identity of image 1. Hand-drawn children's picture-book art only: no photograph, no 3D toy render, and no crude flat geometric icon.
